items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance over excessive interest on subprime auto loans due to GAP fees; date is the announcement date. Amount is approximately $5.7 million in loan relief; the two lenders also pay $225,000 together for implementation, not split and not counted. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 5,700,000 to 0; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-011.
